parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Connect credentials: **Google Sheets** (all sheet nodes), **Gmail** (approval email), **OpenRouter** (AI summary). All are unconfigured on purpose.
2. In **Workflow Configuration** set:
   - `openrouter_model` (TO_CONFIGURE model ID)
   - `approval_recipient_email` (TO_CONFIGURE internal address)
   - `approval_webhook_base_url` (the later approval workflow's webhook)
3. Spreadsheet `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` needs tabs **Leads**, **Audit Log**, **Error Queue**. Rows are auto-mapped to the existing headers; fields without a matching header are ignored.
4. Workflow stays inactive until you publish it.

## Security
- Only the 12 documented fields are accepted; unknown fields -> HTTP 400.
- Browser requests with an Origin other than https://your-landing-page.example.com -> HTTP 403. Set `require_origin_header` to true to also block requests with no Origin.
- Error responses are generic; details go to Error Queue only (no PII, no stack traces).
- The AI sees no email/phone, is told not to diagnose, promise availability or quote prices, and invalid output / confidence < 0.75 forces manual review.
- Approve/Reject links carry a random token stored in Leads; the approval workflow must verify it.
- Customers are never emailed by this workflow. Duplicates are flagged, never deleted.

## Testing
POST JSON to /webhook-test/canyon-glow-lead (test) or /webhook/canyon-glow-lead (after publishing):
{"fullName":"Demo User","email":"demo@example.com","phone":"480-555-0123","zipCode":"85201","serviceType":"no_cooling","urgency":"today","propertyType":"single_family","preferredContactMethod":"phone","problemDescription":"AC blowing warm air, house is 94F inside.","contactConsent":true,"demoDataConfirmation":true,"source":"website"}
Expect 202 with lead_id + status. Try bad ZIP / short description / extra field for 400, wrong Origin for 403. Re-submit the same email within 7 days to see the duplicate flag.

main.node: Parse AI Summary and Set Review Status
Log Lead Accepted to Audit Log
Queue Post-Save Issue in Error Queue

nodeGroups.name: Validate lead request
nodeGroups.description: Checks origin, allowed fields, contact details, ZIP, description length and consents before anything is stored

nodeGroups.name: Reject invalid request
nodeGroups.description: Returns a safe 400/403 message to the caller and records the rejection in the audit log

nodeGroups.name: Prioritize lead
nodeGroups.description: Flags service-area coverage, sets high/medium/low priority, then loads past leads for the duplicate check

nodeGroups.name: Summarize and save lead
nodeGroups.description: Flags 7-day duplicates, gets a guarded AI summary, decides manual review, then appends the lead row

nodeGroups.name: Notify team and confirm
nodeGroups.description: Emails staff approve/reject links, audits the acceptance, queues any email or audit failures, replies 202

nodeGroups.name: Handle failures
nodeGroups.description: Any lookup or save failure is written to the error queue and the caller gets a generic 500 reply
